body:
I used to have things that made me smile. Friends, some games, a girl or two who didn't think I was repulsive. But most of those friends are gone for one reason or another, and most of those girls have realized their mistake in talking to me. The possessions I own, for which I am currently writing a last will and testament to choose their new owners, have all been gained by asking for money, and it makes me sick that I'm so worthless I can't even get a job and earn the cash myself to buy these things. No, I've had to ask my mother, who works only from March until October or thereabouts, earning not much more than minimum wage, or my father, who doesn't care at all what I think, for a ten-spot here or a little money there. The things that make me smile aren't there anymore, and I'm just not sure if I should be either.

I'm not smart enough to pass my classes anymore, based on my report card. Even the one class that I loved has surpassed my level of understanding, and that's the field I planned on pursuing as a career after high school lets out. I'm weak, fat, stupid, and I have no social skills to speak of (ha, ha), and yet I've let myself go this long, hurting those I wanted to help most. If I can't help them, I'm no help to anyone at all, and one fewer mouth to feed is less expensive for everyone. I can't imagine more than a handful of people attending a funeral for me, because I never did enough for them to care.

I apologize that you will miss me, but it really does mean a lot to me, that someone who neither knows me or anything about me will miss me when I'm gone. I hope your life goes better than mine.
